## 41:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos. |
| LOGOS | Ishmael son of Nethaniah carried out his treachery at Mizpah, and the remnant of Judah was thrown into chaos. |
| PNEUMA | Ishmael's treachery at Mizpah plunged the survivors of Judah into utter chaos and fear. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
